decisions.reason: Retaining the gallery hover animations does not change the source, quantity, or other requirements for gallery photographs; the same message's photo discussion is a separate decision.
The hover-animation decision does not alter the gallery category tabs or the optional area for other photography.
The mobile pricing-table interaction is addressed by a separate clause in message 76 and already has its own same-message lifecycle Events; retaining gallery animations does not change it.
Retaining hover animations does not change the requirement that viewers be able to browse and scroll through the interactive gallery.

The animation decision does not change homepage button destinations or navigation behavior; any button confirmation in message 76 is separate execution evidence and must not be propagated as a value change.
Retaining gallery hover animations has no effect on the one-time pricing model or the visibility of monthly and annual pricing tabs.
The hover-animation decision does not change the display or selection of individually priced services.
Retaining gallery hover animations does not alter the requirement for representative images accompanying services.
The gallery animation decision does not change the homepage hero overlay, opacity, or image-emphasis settings.
The animation decision does not change package counts, square-footage ranges, or package prices; the pricing statement in message 76 concerns a separate requirement.
Keeping hover animations is compatible with the site-wide image-focused presentation but does not necessarily modify that broader presentation requirement.
The gallery hover-animation decision has no semantic effect on the deferred instant quote calculator or any of its pricing rules.
